brief:
Mahmoud Abdel-Malek, a 20-year-old goalkeeper for Gaza Sports Club, was killed in an Israeli airstrike on Gaza City, Al Jazeera English reported. The strike occurred days after he played in a cup match organized to honor slain athletes.

The airstrike claimed the life of the young athlete, who represented one of Gaza's sports clubs in the memorial competition held shortly before his death.
dek: Mahmoud Abdel-Malek, a 20-year-old goalkeeper for Gaza Sports Club, was killed in an Israeli airstrike on Gaza City.
title: Israel kills Gaza goalkeeper in airstrike on city
